title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-maya-2026-03-04.json
content:
Daily goals (WK13):
- Outreach goal: 45 touches (calls + emails + LinkedIn)
- Meetings to book: 3
- Pipeline target: $180k influenced this week

Morning plan (9:00-11:30)
- 9:00 quick sync w/ Jamie (5m): confirm AEs for handoffs, priority accounts
- 9:10 call block: 12 outbound calls - focus on inbound trial list + demo no-shows
- 10:30 follow-up emails batch: send personalized follow-ups to 8 prospects (templates below)
- 11:00 LinkedIn connect + 1-touch for sequence recipients

Call list (priority):
1) FinOak Capital - Contact: Priya Raman (Head of ML) - direct line x3 (voicemail yesterday)	Notes: spoke 3/1, interested in latency improvements; asked for perf benchmarks and pricing for 10k TPS. Follow-up: send tailored perf one-pager + ask for 20-min technical sync.
2) Cartwheel Health - Contact: Marco Diaz (CTO) - interested in private deployment compliance	Notes: demo 2/18, needs KMS/HSM details and SOC2 evidence. Follow-up: loop in security PS and request available slots next week.
3) Nimbus Retail - Contact: Elle Park (Product Lead) - using hosted API now, cost concerns	Notes: high token volumes; wants batching suggestions. Follow-up: share Redwood Optimize checklist + propose pilot on Dedicated.
4) Atlas Learning - Contact: Samir Patel (VP Eng) - trial expired	Notes: demo no-show last week; likely budget review in Q2. Follow-up: call + offer recap + updated pricing (volume tiers).
5) Volt Robotics - Contact: Hannah Lee (AI Eng) - cold, high-fit (robotics LLM use)	Notes: new lead from webinar. Action: intro email, 15-min scoping call next Tue.

Email templates / quick snippets
- Quick follow-up (after voicemail):
  Hi <First>,
  Left a voicemail earlier - wanted to share a short perf summary for Redwood and see if you'd be open to a 20-min technical chat. We helped similar teams cut per-token cost 2x via batching+KV caching. Available Tue/Thu mornings.
  - Maya

- Demo recap / pricing nudge:
  Hi <First>,
  Great to demo with you. Attached is the one-pager with Dedicated pricing and common configs. Happy to connect with your security team if helpful.

To-dos / follow-ups (sorted by urgency)
- [ ] Send FinOak perf one-pager + ask for tech sync (today EOD)
- [ ] Create pairing note for Cartwheel security (cc: solutions-eng)
- [ ] Book 15-min intro w/ Volt Robotics (propose Tue 10-11am)
- [ ] Update tracking sheet: move Atlas Learning to "post-demo nurture" and set 3-week cadence
- [ ] Run Redwood Optimize checklist on Nimbus workloads (ask eng for sample token metrics)

Pipeline notes / recent wins
- Won: Elevate Media (SMB) - signed pilot ($25k) - handoff to AE Liz for onboarding 3/15
- Progress: Demo with FinOak went well; technical champion is switching to advocate internally
- Risk: Large mid-market deal (Cartwheel) requires SOC2 evidence - need security attach quickly

Open questions / blockers
- Who owns the SOC2 artifacts for Private deployments? (need contact in security/compliance)
- Do we have an updated Dedicated pricing sheet for >$150k ARR pilots? I have last version from 2025-Q4.
- Is there a quick benchmark deck (5 slides) showing latency comparisons for 8k seq on A100 vs H100?

Meeting notes (from 2026-03-03)
- SDR huddle: focus on outbound personalization - use three-sentence value props and one proof point per email
- AE sync: agree to faster handoffs for qualified inbound (SLA 24h)

Personal reminders / time blocking
- Block 1: 9:10-11:30 outbound calls / emails
- Block 2: 13:00-14:00 admin / CRM updates
- Block 3: 15:30-16:30 follow-up calls + booking

Quick metrics to log at EOD
- Calls made: ___
- Emails sent: ___
- Connects on LI: ___
- Meetings booked: ___

Random notes / snippets
- Experiment: A/B subject lines for Cartwheel: "Redwood + Cartwheel: secure LLM infra" vs "Cut inference cost 30% - quick idea"
- Add template for "security attach" to outreach (include SOC2 link + sample security questionnaire)

Next steps after today
- Update playbook with SOC2 attach template
- Follow up with solutions-eng to get perf one-pager finalized
- Sync with AE Liz on Elevate Media onboarding checklist

End of day quick reflection (fill in later)
- Wins:
- Learnings:
- Blockers:
